description: Pilot test job for the Steel Atlas auto-video pipeline. Three scenes, one highlight subtitle per scene.

scenes.fallback_prompt: dramatic photograph of a tall cable-stayed bridge across a deep valley at dawn
scenes.narration: The Millau Viaduct is the tallest bridge on Earth.

scenes.fallback_prompt: photograph of a bridge mast rising into clouds, low angle
scenes.narration: Its tallest mast rises 343 metres, higher than the Eiffel Tower.

scenes.fallback_prompt: photograph of bridge construction with cranes and concrete pylons
scenes.narration: Engineers built it in just three years, using sliding formwork and satellite-guided cable tensioning.

script: The Millau Viaduct is the tallest bridge on Earth. [HL]Its tallest mast rises 343 metres[/HL], higher than the Eiffel Tower. Engineers built it in just three years, using sliding formwork and satellite-guided cable tensioning.
title: TEST — How the Millau Viaduct Was Built (45-second pilot)
